entities.name: Query acyltransferase
observations: 284 aa, predicted basic protein with molecular weight approximately 32.1 kDa and pI approximately 9.37.
N-terminal region is strongly hydrophobic and consistent with membrane insertion; the C-terminal portion contains the catalytic region.
Pfam Acyltransferase domain PF01553 detected at residues 85–212.
Closest reviewed homologs include human AGPAT1/Q99943, bovine Q95JH2, and mouse O35083, with approximately 58% identity, approximately 85.6% query coverage, and E-values near 10^-102.

entities.name: AGPAT1
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate this enzyme as 1-acyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase alpha.
The enzyme catalyzes acylation of lysophosphatidic acid at the sn-2 position using acyl-CoA, producing phosphatidic acid and CoA.
Annotated EC number is EC 2.3.1.51; associated with phospholipid metabolism and CDP-diacylglycerol biosynthesis.
Annotated localization is endoplasmic-reticulum membrane and multi-pass membrane protein.

entities.name: LPA acylation to phosphatidic acid
observations: The reaction corresponds to Rhea RHEA:19709 and EC 2.3.1.51.
Exact acyl-chain specificity cannot be established from homology alone; retrieved examples include palmitoyl, oleoyl, and heptadecanoyl substrates.
